trigger: Set piece: the ration line surges (enc_ch02_crush).

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Somebody shouts that the flour's gone. It isn't. It doesn't matter. The line folds like a wave.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [Bracing against your leg. Barking at the crowd, high and frantic.]

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: A boy, eight maybe, goes down between the barriers. His mother is screaming a name. Mateo.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: An elbow catches your ribs. Then you have him by the shirt, and you're both out, and he's breathing.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Wraith plants herself in the gap and bares her teeth. The crowd parts around her like water around a rock.

nodes.speaker: rosa
nodes.text: Mateo! Mijo— Thank you. Thank you. I'm Rosa. We're with the Floor. At the Silver Spur. Anything.

nodes.speaker: rosa
nodes.text: If you ever need something, ask for Rosa in the kitchen. I mean it. I don't forget.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You get clear. Behind you, the screaming goes on longer than it should. You don't look back.
